current.text: Miami traded for Giannis Antetokounmpo, so Bam now plays next to him.
Experts expect a small value hit with Giannis on the team. He may lose some rebounds and take more threes, but no big drop is expected.
Miami lacks point guards and ball handlers, so Giannis is expected to handle the ball a lot.
Miami's depth is poor, including at big man. Bobby Portis is his backup.
A rank in the 30s is fair for him. ESPN's rank of 15 is too high, because he has never played near that level.
His fair auction price is in the mid 20s USD. In a mock auction he went for 24 USD, which the expert called too cheap.
Miami has the fewest back-to-backs in the league (13) and none in the fantasy playoffs. It plays only 10 games in the fantasy playoff weeks.

durable.text: His FG% is low for a big on 15 to 16 attempts per game. It fell in each of the last three seasons as he took more threes.
He now shoots threes. Both sites project about 2 made threes per game, which is high for a center.

note: Average costs are about 25 USD on both Yahoo and ESPN, and he went for 26 USD in our league last season. That matches the experts' fair price in the mid 20s, so do not chase ESPN's 45 USD value or its rank of 15. He fits best in punt FG% builds, where his rebounds, points, steals and threes from the center spot count fully. Early in the season, check how much rebounding and shot volume he loses next to Giannis, and whether more threes push his FG% even lower.
